title: Market -like Wage Franky's easiest recipe. Vegetable Frankie | Veg Frankie Roll | Kabitaskitchen
description: #VegetbaleFrankieByKabita #VegRollRecipeByKabita #KabitasKitchen  Preparation time - 30 minutes Serving - 4  Ingredients: Wheat flour -1 cup All purpose flour -1 cup Boiled potatoes - 4 Green chilli -2 Ginger (chopped)- 2 inch Garlic cloves (chopped)- 6 Red chilli powder -1/2 tsp Coriander powder -1/2 tsp Roasted cumin powder - 1 tsp Garam masala powder -1/2 tsp Dry mango powder -1 tsp Salt to taste Cooking oil- 2 tbsp Butter -1 tsp Tomato Cabbage Carrot Capsicum Onion Tomato ketchup - 2 tbsp Mayonnaise -1 tbsp Cheese  Lemon juice - 1 tsp  Music by Kevin MacLeod;  Title - Life of Riley, Parting of the ways Source- http://incompetech.com/ Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0

asr.full_text: Vegetable Pankais and veg Pankais, Hello Friends,I am Mavita and you are welcome to my Kitchen Today I am going to make Vegetable Pankais Today I will be making straight style pankais And that too very easy So stay with this video till the end because you will love this Pankais So Let's start today's recipe of Vegetable Pankais don't forget to like video and subscribe it Make a dough for this. For that take 1 cup all purpose flour and 1 cup all purpose flour Mix it well You can also use all purpose flour or safe flour Mix it nicely Then add water and heat it We will leave the dough for 15 minutes so that dough will rise After 15 minutes knead into a ball you can roll it as we make rotis and chapattis so lets start , first I am making frankie sheet After that we will make masala for frankie then we will move on to final process I have already made lollipops, after this we have to roll for this we have to use flour or dry flour for this we use all purpose flour press a little bit then when we roll roti and This is an easy method and it will taste better Here I will roll one roti differently But do not use other rotis Roll it the same way Our second sheet is ready so will keep it in the same plate Will bake it now Will place it in hot tawa Will bake it till it is not to much over half Turn over and make sure it is well baked And here is one sheet One sheet of Frankie have been cooked And we need to cook another one Make sure Now cook other one When temperature rises, keep the flame on medium So first I have cooked Frankie sheet Take it out Next time we will be making the Aloo Tikki I have placed the dough slightly raw So now put 2-3 tbsp oil in the other pan Add all ingredients in the pan I am using the right amount of ingredients 1 tsp Garlic, 1 tsp Ginger, 1 tsp Green chilli Mix and cook well 1 tsp Garlic, 1 tsp Ginger and 1 tsp Green chilies Mix them and mix all the ingredients in it Keep the flame low To the pan, we will add boiled and peeled 4 boiled potatoes Saute it well Then we will add potatoes After that we will add these potatoes Now add masala usually frankie masala is used for fried fish I will share what is different in this masala Mix potatoes with green, garlic. and ginger Then add special masala Here we have mixed it Now add 1 tsp red chili powder 1 tsp coriander powderth tsp red chili powder, then add 1st to 4th tsp coriander powder and then 1st to 4th tsp cumin powder then add 1st to 4th tsp garam masala powder, then add 1 to 4th tsp black pepper powder, salt and 1tbsp dried mango powder now mix them well you also can use ready made Franky masala Mix it well and cook for 2 mins on low flame I have cooked the dish for 2 mins It gives a delicious aroma Switch off the flame and let it cool down Once it drops completely, we will make tikkis Once it cools down, we will make oval shaped tikkis We have to make those in the same way we make in a normal style We need not add our bread crumbs for it, we need to shallow fry these, so we don't have to spread breadcrumbs We just make these tikkis and then fry them on a pan Our tikkis for potato are ready. Let us put them in a pan Put some oil on tawa Spread oil Keep the tikkis and fry them on medium flame for 2-3 minutes Cook tikkies until they flame for 2-3 minutes We will heat them at this stage until brown colour of crispy layer is seen across both the tikkis Flip them after 1-1.5 minute You can clearly see the crispy layer here flip them Let's cook them for 1-1.5 minutes more 5 minutes are over, it should take some time to remove the tikkis are ready now. Don't cook them longer than this. I took them out. I had fried potatoes earlier so I don't need to cook them again. So the crispy chicken is ready. I will add some butter again on the pan, but you can use any oil if you want. I have added the butter now. It will be better to heat the frankie or roll in a pan once again. When a frankie is made in your kitchen, don't boil or heat it. You can also use oil if needed I have added butter now Now we will again heat the sheet Whether it is frankie or roll, you prefer it hot So let's roast it on pan before serving If you want crispy then you can cook it a little more But I suggest you to cook more I have already cooked it earlier So our frankie sheet is ready After making aloo tikki we have to move on final process So I decided to wrap the florets with the filling For this I am gonna use the frasher I have made my franke shiit of my personal preference So it's not good to use them too much Here our frankey is prepared The frankey with cheese on it makes the frankey shiit much more tasty Now I will start to make frankey wrap Keep these frankey shiit over the frankey And I am going to make green chutney over top of Franky sheet I used coriander and mint leaves chutney You may apply what ever you like There are different types of green chutney recipe in my channel Put some tomato ketchup on the top One side is spicy chutney and one side is tomato ketchup Add ketchup Now i am adding ketchup for flavouring the salad. Now i am adding the potato chips. Now add the potato chips. Add the salad vegetables like onion, tomato, capsicum, cabbage and carrots As per your taste, add capsicum If you do not like raw vegetables, you can skip Add chopped Carrots Add cabbage If you don't prefer cabbage, you can skip it You can also add onions,, Tomatoes and Capsicum Add remaining onion and tomato Sprinkle some salt Add a little bit of lemon juice Add little bit of mayonnaise Add some lemon juice Add some mayonnaise Add very few flavors Add some more mayo Finally we will add cheese to enhance the taste Grate cheese Grated cheese as well Setup for Frankie is ready Do not add the chicken on it To fold, fold from one side and keep it on top of the chicken, place it on another side, wrap it in the foil and then wrap the second side Frankie is ready And ready to serve You could serve it with any other soup, it doesn't taste great Have this in your home! So I am sure, you would like this recipe if you liked this recipe please press LIKE button'll come out great Do lai g and share and subscribe to my channel Thank you. you
